text:
alex: CI deploy to staging failing with 401 invalid_api_key on our chat completions call. Started right after yesterday's secret rotation. Anyone seen this before?

jess: Which endpoint & any logs? Can you paste the failing request/response (redact the key) so we can see headers?

alex: Repro locally with the exact env var we pass into GH Actions: 

````
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/completions \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-mini\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"hi\"}] }'
````

Response (from staging runner):
{"error":{"message":"Invalid API key","type":"invalid_api_key","code":401}}

mike: Can you run `printf "%s" "$API_KEY" | wc -c` locally and in the action runner and paste counts? Trailing newline or stray char is common.

alex: Local returns `40`, action runner log printed `41` when we echo the env var in debug step.
\njess: That 1-byte delta is the smoking gun. GH secrets UI sometimes includes a newline when copying. Try trimming in the job temporarily: `API_KEY=$(echo -n "$API_KEY")` or `echo "$API_KEY" | tr -d '\n'`.

mike: Also check you didn't paste a JSON wrapper by accident. I once saw a secret value like `{"key":"sk_live_..."}` — that adds chars and quotes.

alex: Good catch — when re-creating the secret we accidentally pasted the key with surrounding quotes. Runner debug showed header: `Authorization: Bearer \"sk_live_abc...\"` (quotes included).

jess: That explains the 401. Quick fixes: edit GH secret to the raw key (no quotes/newline) or add a sanitize step in the workflow: `API_KEY=$(echo "$API_KEY" | sed -e 's/^"//; s/"$//' | tr -d '\r\n')`.

alex: I edited the secret (removed quotes and trailing newline), re-ran the workflow — deployment succeeded. Thanks :tada: 

deploy-bot: deployment staging/blue succeeded (run_id: 2026-03-17-313159).

sara: Adding to runbook: when rotating keys include a validation step that checks `printf "%s" "$API_KEY" | xxd -g 1 | tail -n1` to confirm last byte and `wc -c` to confirm length. Also add a GH workflow lint to fail if value contains non-printables or surrounding punctuation.

jess: I'll update the runbook and add a small CI check template.

alex: Closing thread — deploy green. Thanks everyone.
